description: Get hourly perpetual funding rates from Hyperliquid and dYdX v4. Current and predicted rates are compared as indicative spreads; fees and basis risk are excluded. Costs 0.008 USDC per call (x402 micropayment on Base).

asset.description: Asset symbol (e.g. "BTC", "ETH", "SOL"). Returns all assets if omitted.

min_spread.description: Filter for arbitrage spreads >= N basis points (e.g. 0.5). Omit for no filter.

name: get_funding_rates
